items.title: KHC Q2 Deep Dive: Sales Slide Continues, Investment in Brands Ramps Up
items.summary: Packaged foods company Kraft Heinz (NASDAQ:KHC) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 1.4% year on year to $6.26 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.56 per share was 5.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Unusual Options Activity: Kraft Heinz Trader Bets Big on a Bull Call Spread — With Low Risk, Big Reward
items.summary: Kraft Heinz had three unusually active options in Wednesday trading. However, two of them had Vol/OI ratios in the top three yesterday. More importantly, the two trades accounted for 96% of the two call options’ volume.

items.title: KHC Q2 Earnings Call Raises Brand Spending on Early Traction
items.summary: Kraft Heinz is adding $100 million to second-half marketing as consumption and share improve, building toward volume-led growth in 2027.

items.title: JPMorgan upgrades Kraft Heinz credit to Overweight on deleveraging outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan upgraded its credit recommendation on Kraft Heinz to Overweight from Neutral, citing better-than-expected quarterly results, disciplined balance sheet management and greater confidence that the packaged food maker can fund higher investment in its brands while keeping leverage under control.

items.title: Kraft Heinz (KHC) Is Down 6.8% After Massive Impairment-Fueled Loss Amid Ongoing Turnaround Investments
items.summary: Kraft Heinz recently reported second-quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$6,262 million and a net loss of US$5,460 million, largely driven by very large goodwill and intangible asset impairment charges, while also affirming a regular US$0.40 quarterly dividend and completing a US$1.51 billion share repurchase program.
